title: How far does a slow tortoise walk in half an hour?
description: {{NAME_1}} watches a pet tortoise on a straight path. The tortoise walks one quarter of a kilometre in one whole hour, and the video stops on how far it walks in half an hour, with no answer shown.
teaching_notes: One idea: a part of an hour covers a part of the distance of one hour. Ask each child for a guess and how it was found, and do not confirm or reject any guess, because the next topics settle it. Watch for students who think half an hour must give half a kilometre.

source: A tortoise on a garden path
video_script.why: Before any rule, the child meets a real slow walk where only a part of an hour is watched.
video_script.substitution: Picture the path with one quarter of a kilometre marked for a whole hour, and a half hour waiting to be measured.
video_script.anchor: {{NAME_1}}'s tortoise walks one quarter of a kilometre in one hour: how far in half an hour?

names.{{NAME_1}}: walks 3 km in 1 hour; his pet tortoise walks 1/4 km in 1 hour

never_show: any distance for the half hour
maths_rules: The tortoise walks 1/4 km in 1 hour.
{{NAME_1}} watches it for half an hour.
The open question: how far in half an hour. The answer is never shown or hinted.
video_script.design: One idea: a part of an hour covers a part of the distance of one hour. Assumes the child knows halves and quarters. Wrong idea: none is broken. The photo sits as a dimmed backdrop in the first beat and fades before the drawn path arrives; the path stays to the end.
